messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Nicole James <nicole@talentbridge.com>
Date: 2026-07-19 09:12 -07:00
Subject: Coverage gap for Tue 21 candidate loop — urgent bridge & shadow plan

Team —

Heads up: we just had three interviewers out with last-minute conflicts for the Alex Patel loop on Tue 21 (10:00–15:00 PT). This is a high-priority hire for infra; we need to lock the loop or we risk rescheduling the candidate (bad for momentum). Attached the current loop_schedule_20260721.xlsx and Alex_Patel_Resume.pdf.

As a stop-gap we need:
- one system/design interviewer (10:00 slot)
- two behavioral/leadership panels (midday)
- one coding session (afternoon)

Can you reply with which slots you can cover, or propose a shadow/bridge pairing so we can keep the loop intact? If we can’t cover everything, I’ll ask Nicole to offer alternative times but prefer to hold the original day.

Also: if we bring in shadows, please flag whether you want them to grade or only observe — we should avoid double scoring without calibration.

Marissa
VP, Eng Hiring
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Alex_Patel_Resume.pdf (PDF), loop_schedule_20260721.xlsx (Excel)

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nicole James <nicole@talentbridge.com>
Date: 2026-07-19 10:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage gap for Tue 21 candidate loop — urgent bridge & shadow plan

Thanks Marissa — quick plan below (volunteering to stitch the gaps):

1) 10:00–10:40 PT — System Design: I can cover this slot; I'll act as primary interviewer. Propose pairing a shadow (Laura) to take notes + calibration; shadow will not score unless we explicitly agree.

2) 11:10–11:50 PT — Backend deep dive: Laura, can you take this as primary? If so, Ethan will shadow then join the 30-minute debrief.

3) 13:00–13:40 PT — Leadership/behavioral: Karthik, can you step in? If you're OK, we’ll have Marissa join that panel as a co-interviewer for calibration.

4) 14:30–15:10 PT — Coding: I can move my afternoon block to cover coding if needed; otherwise we push candidate to a different interviewer.

I'm attaching proposed_invites.ics with tentative slot assignments that will be updated once we confirm. If anyone is only able to observe, mark as SHADOW in the event title so Nicole can set expectations for the candidate.

If no one can cover the coding slot, we should still run the rest of the loop and have the hiring manager run a 30-min follow-up tech screen later that day.

Ethan
Sr Staff Engineer, Infra
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_invites.ics (calendar invites)

I can take the Backend deep dive (11:10 slot) as primary. Will need the loop rubric and a one-line summary of the areas Alex has worked on (infra storage, latency optimizations?) so I can focus the questions. I’m happy to shadow system design for calibration, but I’ll be SHADOW-only there (don’t have time to grade both).

Request: can someone drop the rubric_v2.pdf into the event so all interviewers use the same criteria? Also +1 on a 30-min debrief immediately after the loop (15:30 PT) — we can lock decisioning and score alignment then.

Hi all —

Just confirming Alex is still available for Tue 21 at the times discussed. He signed the candidate NDA this morning — attaching nda_signed.pdf. Alex asked for one small change: prefers the coding exercise to be 45 minutes instead of 40 if possible; he can do 45 but requested a short buffer before the leadership panel.

If you decide to keep the coding at 40, he’s fine and will be ready. Otherwise Nicole can shift a micro break into the schedule — let me know final timings and I’ll update the candidate.

Also: Alex sent his public GitHub (github.com/alexpatel) and a quick note: worked on distributed KV store performance (2 yrs) and led SLA improvements at last role.

Thanks —
